title: Events
description: data/events.json, and the workspace's events: the special Tokens that land on the mat about once an hour of play, keyed by event id. Loaded by src/config/registries/eventRegistry.js (shape and checks: src/config/eventTable.js; the clock: src/systems/events/EventClock.js); authored on the CMS's Events page (cms/src/components/events/, cms/src/engine/events.js). Keys not listed here are reported as warnings.

id.description: The event id, the same as its key.

name.description: What the player reads: the banner and the return report.

kind.description: node: a rich node, gone at 0 charges (or after an hour when no hero can work it). buff: one effect in reach for a set time.

weight.description: Its share of the draw among the events that fit the place; 0 never lands.

ground.description: Stands-on words it may land on; empty: wherever its Token may stand.

biomes.description: Region biomes it may land in; empty: any Region.

durationMinutes.description: A buff's time on the mat, in minutes.
